shots.name: T04b_fire_ground
shots.setup: (() => { const h = G.hero, V = h.pos.constructor; G.filmCam = null; const SP = G.combat.powers && G.combat.powers.spout; if (SP && SP.clear) SP.clear(); h.carried = null; if (G.sky.setHour) G.sky.setHour(0.40); G.ember.setSide('fire', { place: true, quiet: true }); G.enemies.clearAll && G.enemies.clearAll(); for (const q of G.enemies.encounters) q.cleared = true; h.maxHp = h.hp = 900; h.tide = h.maxTide; for (const k in h.powers) h.powers[k] = true; h.inv = 1e6; const yaw = h.heading; for (const [dx, dz] of [[6, 5], [-5, 6], [7, -3], [-6, -4]]) G.enemies.spawn(dx === 7 ? 'duelist' : 'reaver', new V(h.pos.x + dx, h.pos.y, h.pos.z + dz)); G.camYaw = yaw + 0.5; G.camPitch = 0.14; window.__n = 0; return 'ok'; })()
shots.each: window.__n++; const n = window.__n, h = G.hero; h.inv = 1e6; h.hp = h.maxHp; h.tide = h.maxTide; for (const e of G.enemies.alive()) if (e.hp < 60 && !e.hornet) e.hp = 200; const w = { mx: 0, my: 0 }; const PP = { 6: 'atk', 18: 'atk', 30: 'atk', 50: 'dash', 75: 'atk', 87: 'atk', 99: 'atk', 120: 'spin', 150: 'wave' }; if (PP[n]) w[PP[n]] = true; Q.drive(w);

shots.name: T13b_city_dolly
shots.setup: (() => { const h = G.hero, V = h.pos.constructor; if (G.sky.setHour) G.sky.setHour(0.66); G.ember.setSide('fire', { place: false, quiet: true }); G.enemies.clearAll && G.enemies.clearAll(); h.inv = 1e6; h.maxHp = h.hp = 900; h.respawn(new V(-680 + 250, 40, -(700 + 32)), -Math.PI / 2); h.fireAir = true; h.air = true; h.fly = true; G.camYaw = -Math.PI / 2; G.camPitch = 0.02; G.filmCam = () => { const p = h.drawPos || h.pos; G.camera.position.set(p.x + 13, p.y + 2.5, p.z + 3.5); G.camera.up.set(0, 1, 0); G.camera.lookAt(p.x - 25, p.y + 4, p.z - 1); }; window.__n = 0; return 'ok'; })()
shots.each: const h = G.hero; window.__n++; h.inv = 1e6; h.pos.y = Math.max(h.pos.y, 38); h.pos.z = -(700 + 32); Q.drive({ boost: true, mx: 0, my: 0 });
